memberdef.type: cslt::UniquePtr< cslt::Dict< K, V >, cslt::DictDeleter< K, V > >
memberdef.name: DictPtr

xrefdescription.para: Verify that foreach() works with a file-scope function pointer
Verify that init() succeeds with a valid capacity and returns a non-null pointer with correct initial state
Verify that init() with capacity 1 rounds up to the minimum of 8
Verify that init() rounds capacity up to the next power of two
Verify that init() returns an error when capacity is zero
Verify that init() works correctly for a non-trivial value type
Verify that init() works correctly for a struct key type
Verify that insert() stores an int->float pair and increments hash_size
Verify that insert() correctly stores multiple distinct int->float pairs
Verify that insert() rejects a duplicate key and returns false
Verify that insert() works correctly for a struct key type
Verify that insert() works correctly for a non-trivial value type
Verify that insert() triggers growth when the load factor is exceeded
Verify that insert() returns false when growth is disabled and the dict is full
Verify that update() overwrites the value for an existing int key
Verify that update() does not change hash_size
Verify that update() returns false for a key that does not exist
Verify that update() works correctly for a non-trivial value type
Verify that pop() removes an int key and returns the correct value
Verify that pop() decrements hash_size correctly
Verify that pop() returns an error for a key that does not exist
Verify that pop() works correctly for a non-trivial value type
Verify that the same key can be re-inserted after being popped
Verify that get() returns the correct float value for an existing key
Verify that get() returns an error for a missing key
Verify that get() does not modify the dict
Verify that get() works correctly for a struct key
Verify that get() works correctly for a non-trivial value type
Verify that get_ptr() returns a non-null pointer to the correct value
Verify that get_ptr() returns nullptr for a missing key
Verify that get_ptr() reflects a value updated via update()
Verify that has_key() returns true for an existing int key
Verify that has_key() returns false for a missing key
Verify that has_key() returns false after a key is popped
Verify that has_key() works correctly for a struct key type
Verify that clear() removes all entries and resets hash_size to zero
Verify that clear() does not change the bucket count
Verify that insert() works correctly after a clear()
Verify that clear() correctly destructs non-trivial value types
Verify that foreach() visits every key-value pair exactly once
Verify that foreach() on an empty dict calls the callback zero times
Verify that copy() produces an independent deep copy
Verify that the single-argument copy() overload uses the source allocator
Verify that copy() correctly copies non-trivial value types
Verify that merge() combines two non-overlapping dicts correctly
Verify that merge() with overwrite == true uses b's value on conflict
Verify that merge() with overwrite == false keeps a's value on conflict
Verify that merge() does not modify the source dicts
Verify that hash_size() tracks insertions and pops correctly
Verify that is_empty() returns true on a fresh dict and false after insert
Verify that bucket_count() returns a power of two >= the requested capacity
Verify that size() returns the number of occupied buckets, which is <= hash_size()
